body: I photograph weddings the way I photograph everything else: close enough to see, far enough to stay out of it. Most of my work is people, in Montréal and wherever they take me.
On your day I arrive early and stay quiet. I'd rather you remember your guests than my camera.
about.link: See the rest of my work on lilispics.com

steps.why: A few lines about your day are enough. The reply card below takes a minute.
We talk about the day you have in mind, and you see whether we get along.
A short contract and a retainer. From then on, the date is yours.
The timeline, the family list, and the places worth a detour.
For the hours of your collection, from the first coffee onward.
A handful of photographs, so you're not left waiting with nothing.
Online, to download and share. Then the album, if you chose one.

collections.addons: You can add a second photographer, an engagement session, a printed album, or a roll of 35 mm film.

items.q: Do we need to know how to pose?
items.a: No. Most of the day I photograph what happens without stepping in. For the portraits I give simple directions, like where to walk or where to look, and then I let you be together.

items.q: Do you do family group photos?
items.a: Yes. You send me a list before the wedding, and someone who knows the family helps me call people in. It usually takes about twenty minutes.

items.q: Do you work with a second photographer?
items.a: For full days I can bring a second photographer I trust, so both sides of the morning are covered. It's an add-on to the collection.
I can shoot a roll or two of 35 mm film alongside the digital photographs. The scans arrive with your gallery.

items.q: How do we reserve our date?
items.a: After our call I send a short contract and an invoice for the retainer. Your date is reserved once both are back.

items.q: Is there a retainer or a payment plan?
items.a: A retainer reserves the date, and the balance is due before the wedding. If you need to spread it out, tell me and we'll find a schedule.
Yes, anywhere in Québec and beyond. Travel costs are added to the quote, and you know the amount before you reserve.

items.q: How many weddings do you take each year?
items.a: A limited number, so each couple gets my full attention before and after the day.
We bring umbrellas and find a covered spot with good light. Some of my favourite photographs were taken in the rain.

items.q: Can you work in dark venues?
items.a: Yes. I use flash when the room is dark, and I keep it soft so it doesn't interrupt the evening.

items.q: Do you need a meal and a break?
items.a: For days longer than six hours, a meal during dinner is appreciated. I eat when the guests eat, so I never miss the speeches.

items.q: When do we see the photos?
items.a: A first selection three days after the wedding, and the full gallery about six weeks later.
Yes. We design the album together once the gallery is delivered, and a bindery I trust prints it.

items.q: Can we ask you not to share our photographs?
items.a: Of course. Tell me before the wedding or at any time after, and your photographs stay private.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what happens to the details you send me through this site, in line with Québec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25).

sections.heading: Who is responsible
body: I'm Lili, the photographer behind Lilis Pics, and I'm the person responsible for protecting your personal information. You can reach me at hello@lilispics.com.

sections.heading: What I collect
body: When you send the reply card: your names, email address, wedding date, venue or city, number of guests, collection, budget range, how you heard about me, and your message.
This site does not use advertising cookies or trackers.

sections.heading: Why
body: Only to answer your request, prepare a quote and, if you book, organise the photography of your wedding. I never sell or share your details for marketing.

sections.heading: Where it is kept
body: Your details are stored with Supabase, my database provider, and the notification email goes through Resend. These providers may keep data outside Québec. [HOSTING REGION TO CONFIRM]

sections.heading: How long
body: I keep a request for [RETENTION PERIOD TO CONFIRM] after our last exchange, then delete it. If you book, your details become part of your contract file.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your information, or withdraw your consent, at any time by writing to hello@lilispics.com. I answer within 30 days.
If you are not satisfied with my answer, you can contact the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
